archetypes.name: dyn-report-format
archetypes.rationale: Run-summary punctuation changes touch parsers, renderers, and many fixture expectations.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed run-summary and report-rendering code for format consistency. Focus on whether colon headings are emitted everywhere new summaries are produced, while legacy stalled headings remain recoverable. Check that table placeholder changes do not break downstream parsing or readability. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
